title: Jarren Duran: ‘I thought I was going to be released’ by Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox outfielder Jarren Duran thought he might be released amid trade deadline moves and his struggles at the plate.
Duran has a .200 batting average but still aims for a potential 20-20 season with 15 home runs and 16 stolen bases.
Boston decided to keep Duran for the remainder of the season despite his performance and trade rumors.

title: Wu, Councilor Louijeune lead more than 100 elected officials in urging Congress to extend protections for Haitians
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Boston Mayor Michelle Wu and Councilor Ruthzee Louijeune urge Congress to extend TPS for Haitians until early 2029.
The appeal followed a Supreme Court decision allowing the Trump administration to end TPS for Haitian immigrants.
Officials argue TPS holders boost the U.S. economy by $4.4 to $5.9 billion annually and fill vital workforce roles.

title: Durbin hits grand slam and Abreu goes deep twice as streaking Red Sox rout White Sox 14-2
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Caleb Durbin hit a grand slam in the first inning as the Red Sox beat the White Sox 14-2.
Wilyer Abreu hit two solo home runs, contributing to Boston's six-game winning streak.
Patrick Sandoval earned his first win since 2024, allowing two runs over five-plus innings.

title: What Adley Rutschman said about joining Red Sox after blockbuster trade
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman joins the Red Sox in a trade involving Carlos Narvaez and several prospects from the Baltimore Orioles.
Rutschman is currently dealing with wrist inflammation and does not have a set timeline for his return to playing.
Rutschman expressed excitement about joining the Red Sox and aims to integrate with the pitching staff during his recovery.

title: Lawsuit against Suffolk DA, BPD aims to force release of footage of fatal police shooting in Roxbury
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A nonprofit sued Boston Police and Suffolk DA for withholding footage of Stephenson King's fatal shooting despite transparency demands.
The lawsuit claims agencies improperly cited investigatory exemptions to deny public records requests for the March 11 shooting footage.
Officer Nicholas O'Malley, charged with manslaughter, shot King during a carjacking response; footage release is contested.

title: Could Roman Anthony, Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox this season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Garrett Crochet began throwing after a two-month break, signaling potential progress despite ongoing left shoulder and lat injuries.
Roman Anthony, recovering from wrist and finger injuries, progressed to batting practice, aiming for return in September.
Other Red Sox updates include Trevor Story's recovery nearing a rehab assignment, while Kutter Crawford remains far from returning.

title: ‘We’ve got to make up for lost time’: After lengthy absence, Gabe Jacas faces a new challenge
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Gabe Jacas finally signed a 4-year, $8.6 million contract with the New England Patriots after lengthy negotiations.
Jacas's contract includes an injury waiver due to a previous offseason knee 'clean up' procedure, ensuring protection for the Patriots.
Coach Mike Vrabel emphasized the need for Jacas to catch up on missed practices and praised his eagerness and effort in training.

title: Skeletal remains found in South Boston home turn out to be animal bones, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Police determined skeletal remains found in a South Boston home were animal bones, not human.
Officers discovered the bones at 8 Glover Court after being alerted by people working on the property.
A bag containing shoes was also found near the remains, and the investigation remains active.

title: Drake Maye, offense finish strong and other takeaways from Day 9 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye completed 11 of his final 12 passes to finish strong in Patriots training camp.
A.J. Brown returned as a full participant after dislocating his thumb, impressing in head-to-head battles.
DeMario Douglas is vying for a more prominent role, showing versatility in the Patriots' offensive setups.

title: Family of Abington teen killed in crash during police chase says car was not stolen
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Sebastian Hamilton, 17, died in a crash after a police chase in Abington involving an allegedly stolen SUV.
Family claims the SUV was taken without permission by a friend of the passengers; police say it was reported stolen.
The crash injured four teen passengers; the officer involved has been placed on leave as the incident is investigated.
